item.description: In electroencephalography, hair remains a major barrier to electrode-skin contact, limiting signal quality. Here, we introduce electronic hair (eHAIR), a strategy that converts hair into a bioelectronic interface using mixed ionic-electronic conductive polymer dyes. item.description: A central challenge in neuroscience is to understand how the brain flexibly balances local and distributed information processing to support diverse cognitive and conscious states. item.title: Nicotine pouch use and associated characteristics among U.S. adults: Tobacco use supplement to the current population survey, 2022-2023
item.description: CONCLUSIONS: Nicotine pouch use was low among U.S. young adults (18-24 years) and adults (≥25 years) in 2022-2023. Given the higher prevalence estimates of current nicotine pouch use among people who ever use in May 2023 than in September 2022, ongoing surveillance is important to monitor patterns of use.

item.title: The p16 isoform of CDKN2A inhibits ferroptosis to promote the progression of papillary thyroid carcinoma by influencing the p53/SLC7A11/GPX4 pathway
item.description: CONCLUSION: CDKN2A promotes PTC progression by suppressing ferroptosis via indirect regulation of p53/SLC7A11/GPX4 pathway, primarily through the p16 isoform. Targeted inhibition of p16 isoform is a potential therapeutic strategy for PTC.

item.description: Extracellular signal-regulated kinases (ERKs) have essential roles in development and are implicated in numerous diseases. item.description: Methylation is a fundamental post-translational modification best understood as regulating chromatin structure and gene expression, yet there is emerging evidence that methylation also shapes cytoskeletal organization, regulating key processes such as mitosis and cell migration. item.description: The translocase of the outer membrane (TOM) mediates the import of most mitochondrial preproteins. item.description: Microbial communities often exhibit apparently complex dynamics driven by myriad interactions among community members and with their environments.
